    ("obj_literal", re.compile(r'^(?P<indent>\s*)(?:const|let|var)\s+(?P<name>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*=\s*\{'))
]

definitions={}
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('web'):
    for file in files:
        if file.endswith('.js') or file.endswith('.ts'):
            path=os.path.join(root,file)
            with open(path,'r',encoding='utf-8',errors='ignore') as f:
                for i,line in enumerate(f,1):
                    for kind, pat in patterns:
                        m=pat.search(line)
                        if m:
                            name=m.group('name')

# duplicates

    if len(defs)>1:
        print(f"{name} has {len(defs)} defs")
        for (p,i,kind,line) in defs:
            print(f"  {p}:{i} [{kind}] {line}")
        print()
